en.quote: De jure and de facto, there is no mandatory coronavirus vaccination in Russia.
en.head: Vaccination was already mandatory for some workers.
en.body: Peskov said compulsory vaccination did not exist in Russia “de jure or de facto”. Yet a Moscow order issued on 15 June 2021 required a specified share of workers in several service sectors to be vaccinated. There was no nationwide mandate for everyone, but a legal requirement applied to some occupational groups.

osrc.t: Order of Moscow’s Chief Sanitary Doctor, June 15, 2021
